content:
Sam (SRE): Posted the postmortem for the tenant isolation event (peering flap + on-prem route leak). Short: race during peering failover + mis-applied customer route-policy. Link in docs.

postmortem-bot: New postmortem created: /incidents/1865554321-tenant-isolation-postmortem.md

Irene (Platform): Can we capture owners/dues here so we can create tickets?

Sam (SRE): Action items:
- Peering health probes (control + data) 1 owner: Irene (Platform) 1 due: 2026-06-07
- On-prem policy detection tests 1 owner: Marco (Support) 1 due: 2026-06-14
- Onboarding isolation checklist (passive checks by default) 1 owner: Marco (Support) 1 due: 2026-05-31
- Customer comms + one-pager for NOC 1 owner: Tara (CS) 1 due: 2026-05-29

Irene (Platform): I'll open INF-5010 for the probe work. Plan: daemon on dedicated nodes running control-plane verify + TCP handshake to peer IPs.

Marco (Support): I'll build the verification script. Default passive mode: `ip route`, `ip neigh`, `iptables -L`. Optional active capture if customer opts in. ETA 4 days.

Tara (CS): I'll draft comms and the NOC checklist, sending to legal today. Note: customer requested step-by-step safe-checks they can run.

Sam (SRE): Observations: this is the second similar peering-route incident in 6 months. Propose recurring monthly "isolation pattern" review to spot config anti-patterns. Owner: Sam. Start: 2026-06-03.

Irene (Platform): Also adding an onboarding linter rule to flag default-originate entries lacking explicit next-hop validation. Will include in INF-5011.

Marco (Support): Quick Q: many customers won't share on-prem logs. Confirming script is useful in passive-only mode?

Sam (SRE): Yes — passive-only should catch most cases; active checks for deeper debugging with consent. Document both in runbook.

Irene (Platform): I'll link PRs and ticket numbers into the postmortem doc. Please update issue tracker when PRs land.

All: :thumbsup:
